text: 据中国汽车工业协会，10月10日，工业和信息化部会同公安部、生态环境部、市场监管总局等部门，研究起草了《关于进一步加强汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证有关管理工作的通知（征求意见稿）》，聚焦整治不合理创新设计、健全研发测试验证管理体系，通过提高汽车产品准入管理要求，压实企业产品安全主体责任。中国汽车工业协会对此举措坚决支持，并面向全行业发出倡议，全面提升我国汽车产品安全水平。
text_en: According to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, on October 10, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, together with the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the State Administration for Market Regulation and other departments, drafted the Notice on Further Strengthening the Management of Innovative Design and R&D Testing and Verification of Automotive Products (Draft for Comment), focusing on rectifying unreasonable innovative designs and improving the R&D testing and verification management system, and by raising vehicle product access management requirements, consolidating enterprises' primary responsibility for product safety. The China Association of Automobile Manufacturers firmly supports this measure and issued an initiative to the entire industry to comprehensively improve the safety level of China's automotive products.
